findings.detail: Exact frozen telegram_lifecycle_ffi.erl fails illegal binary pattern at line15. HTTP-only compile excludes the preserved unmodified FFI; not a whole-candidate build.
Public pure validator accepts uos-tg-store-test-*;fake. FFI concatenates prefix-only input into os:cmd and ignores stop exit. No shell exploit or lifecycle stop executed.
Public mint_verified_receipt_for_test accepts arbitrary cgroup.events path; stop receipt accepts caller DB/hash association/cgroup root. Missing durable owned registration/incarnation binding.

All positive and negative requests reached a private socket but return hackney_not_available_undef. Pinned Hackney request/5 returns BodyBinary and has no body/1; existing FFI calls removed function. Negative response cases are UNREACHED, not PASS.
config.timeout_ms unused, synchronous full-body read before size check; poll and callback no body limit; raw errors/descriptions reflected; callback checks ok without result true.

Public AuthorityLease and caller now_us establish only self-asserted authority; reviewed canonical provider/current request task not wired. No fresh fence after polling or before HTTP after store commit.
DB workers launched before cleanup, only first64 rows inspected, any Some receipt accepted, no complete bounded scan/outbox recovery. Processing-only detection misses unknown pending DB writer.
Synchronous functions and copyable in_flight Bool do not implement OTP ownership/single-flight or bounded monitored children.
Store failures stringify original context and return errors; unknown writer must retain exact pending request and put service on hold before any additional worker.
